# MedEu.Ai

> MedEu.Ai is a 24/7 personal AI teacher and educational platform for Indian government exam preparation — SSC, WBCS, WBPSC, Railway, Banking and Police — in Bengali, Hindi and English.

MedEu.Ai combines an always-available AI teacher with AI-generated mock tests, previous-year questions and performance analytics, explaining every wrong answer in the learner's chosen medium.

- Founder: Rahamat Ali
- Support: hello.medeu.ai@gmail.com
- Languages: English, हिन्दी, বাংলা
- Site: https://medeu-ai.lovable.app
